name: UFC | svc.apply_card_changes
description: Applies card changes recorded by svc.detect_card_changes: rewrites the Fight Card, renumbers or voids picks, flags affected videos for re-analysis and sends one Telegram summary.

nodeGroups.name: Read card, picks and transcripts
nodeGroups.description: Load the recorded change, the Fight Card, the three pick tabs, this event's videos and transcripts, then plan the update.

nodeGroups.name: Verify and record the new card
nodeGroups.description: Read every written column back, save the new card to the state table, and flag affected videos for re-analysis.
